evidence: Static: task/tests/scoring.toml, tests/test.sh and tests/tools/score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty; sha256 95f70d6e..., bd682592..., 13de2b38...). scoring.toml L1-3 [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; L5-8 weights functional .6/polish .2/visual .2 (sum 1, gates absent from weights); L10-11 [floors] functional=0.05. No judge.toml [judge] block carries a weight key; gate judges are aggregation=all_pass with a single binary criterion each (render/authenticated_render, constraints/server_backed_local_application). Ordering/skip: test.sh L60 write_zero_reward first, L61 trap ensure_reward; L212 rm -rf $LOG_DIR/scored before gates (no stale scored data); L213-214 gate-suite timeout/failure exits with zero record; L217-222 score.py exit 1 (gate failed) exits 0 before scored suite, exit>=2 writes plain zero; scored suite L224 only reached when gates pass. score.py L41 gates_passed = all(score > 0.0); L42-44 scored dimensions forced to 0.0 unless gates passed and scored data exists; L46 weighted uses only [weights] (gates carry no mass); L47-48 reward = 0.0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed; floors_passed requires functional > 0.05 strictly. Gate-stage call writes reward 0.0 (scored_ran False), so a scored-suite timeout (L224-225 exit 0) leaves a zero reward. Executed (scratch copy of frozen scoring.toml + tools/score.py, Python 3.12.10, synthetic RewardKit JSON): render=0 -> exit 1, reward 0, polish/visual 0; constraints=0 even with a stale perfect scored file -> reward 0; gates pass + functional 0 + polish 1 + visual 1 -> reward 0.0 (weighted 0.4, floors_passed 0); functional = one 1.5-weight criterion (1.5/34=0.044) + perfect polish/visual -> reward 0.0; one 2.0 criterion (0.0588) -> 0.4353; missing gate dimension -> exit 2 (test.sh writes plain zero). So a non-working app that passes only the cheap gates earns exactly 0 (matches internal annotation), and polish/visual cannot be farmed without at least one real >=2.0-weight functional pass (each needs a positive control per functional prompt). Scored prompts (functional L11-18, polish L10-17, visual L18-25) also restate the in-dimension browser gate zeroing blank/static/facade apps. Conforming alternative: gate prompts and criteria are generic reachability/sign-in and server-backing checks; a correct app with a different UI is not blocked by gate wording, and gates are binary so cannot shift the shaped score. Limits: no full configured test.sh/RewardKit run exists (raw-evidence-index scope says full configured grading absent); the RewardKit dimension-key contract is unmeasured here but score.py fails closed (exit 2 -> zero) if keys mismatch, so this row's claims do not depend on it. Cross-row observation (not a row-43 defect; template-controlled floor/weights): a thin read-only app that passes signin_and_client_scope (0.059) and perhaps deleted_and_expired_seed_messages (0.088) clears the 0.05 floor and could collect polish/visual (several polish/visual criteria inspect seeded hold/timer marks and layout), giving roughly 0.44-0.49. That is partial credit for partially working software, relevant to rows 39/42/44, not a non-working app farming craft.
